dog.description_text: Breeze is a sweet, affectionate, and energetic young pup, around 3 years old, who was found running loose alongside another female dog. He loves attention and has plenty of youthful energy to share! Breeze would benefit from continued training to help him develop good manners, including learning to keep his mouth to himself, as he can be mouthy with mild pressure during interactions. He is looking for an experienced owner who can provide consistent guidance, structure, and positive reinforcement to help him become the best version of himself.
